    AI Overview
    In a historic 2026 NCAA Tournament Elite Eight matchup, the #3 seed Illinois Fighting Illini defeated the #9 seed Iowa Hawkeyes 71-59 on
    March 28, 2026, in Houston, advancing to their first Final Four since 2005. Illinois dominated the frontcourt, led by freshman Keaton Wagler's 25 points, ending Iowa's surprise tournament run. 
    Key Timeline Events (2026 Season): 
    • Jan. 11, 2026: Illinois beat Iowa 75-69 in their only regular-season meeting at Carver-Hawkeye Arena, led by 19 points from Keaton Wagler, according to KCCI.
    • March 26, 2026: Iowa advances to Elite Eight, according to this YouTube video
    • March 26, 2026 (Sweet 16): Illinois defeats #2 seed Houston 65-55 to advance to the Elite Eight, as noted on the University of Illinois Athletics website.
    • March 28, 2026 (Elite Eight): Illinois beats Iowa 71-59 in Houston to advance to the Final Four, as described by ESPN. 
    Historical Context: 
    • Illinois leads the all-time series against Iowa 96-77.
    • The 2026 Elite Eight meeting was the first-ever matchup between the two programs in the NCAA Tournament.
    • Illinois has won 10 of the last 11 games in the series against Iowa.
